title: PD Control Interpretation of a One-Eighth-Car Suspension Design
expert_review: An insightful reinterpretation of mechanical suspension design as a PD control problem with strong robustness margins.
learning_objectives: Reinterpret mechanical designs as control systems
Identify PD controller structures in physical models
Apply Bode plots for robustness evaluation
Use the Nyquist criterion for stability analysis
Interpret gain and phase margins in physical systems
